statement: mu_H := rho_H dV_H is the parent Hilbert source measure, including ordinary matter, binding, pressure and Hilbert-owned EM stress.
consequence: This keeps Poynting inside T_total on the single Maxwell-Hodge source branch, rather than adding it twice.

statement: If mu_H=mu_bar[q(Phi)] and v is vertical, then along any vertical path Phi_s with q(Phi_s)=q(Phi_0), mu_H(Phi_s)=mu_H(Phi_0) as a Radon measure.
consequence: This is stronger than an infinitesimal density slogan: it is equality of the source measure on the whole vertical fibre.

statement: Exact equality of Radon measures implies supp(mu_H(Phi_s))=supp(mu_H(Phi_0)); therefore W_H is invariant when selected before readout.
consequence: The normal support velocity is zero: V_n_bound=0 on the strict q-basic support branch.

statement: If the measure is exactly constant on the vertical fibre, no distributional source layer is born or killed.
consequence: mu_birth_TV=0 follows from measure equality, not from assuming a plateau.

statement: The Reynolds shell product contains rho_H_trace_norm V_n_bound; if V_n_bound=0 and mu_birth_TV=0, shell zero does not require proving rho_H_trace_norm=0.
consequence: Zero trace remains a sufficient route, but support invariance is a cleaner route if parent source q-basicness is signed.

statement: Radiative/open Poynting flux can change the energy crossing a collar; that is not erased by support invariance and must be routed to the boundary flux row.
consequence: Stationary isolated collars can set Phi_wall_Poynting=0; open collars need the finite wall-flux bound.
